body:
The worker07 campaign proposal at `be2f4c36d3d4ed79aabe29401c555ae3fd65d7b0` closes all 17 occurrences of `Mg(SO4) x 7 H2O` as `existing_identity_or_alias` and adds a resolving RAW_TEXT alias to the pure magnesium sulfate heptahydrate owner. CHEBI:31795 is correct for the solute. The problem is supplied-stock applicability.

At least three frozen CultureMech root occurrences (CultureMech:014409, :014591 and :014959; MediaDive solutions5518,5736,6270) are volumetric stock additions. The [DSMZ1592 recipe](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium1592.pdf), [DSMZ1593 recipe](https://www.dsmz.de/microorganisms/medium/pdf/DSMZ_Medium1593.pdf) and [MediaDive6270 primary record](https://mediadive.dsmz.de/rest/solution/6270) specify10mL of7.5g/L magnesium sulfate heptahydrate stock. A global resolving synonym on the solute does not distinguish that preparation from its component. The frozen CultureMech percent-volume annotation is retained as source evidence, not accepted as a corrected dose.

Before integration, review all17 source occurrences and separate true solute cases from stock-input cases. Preserve valid hydrate chemistry. Where evidence defines the preparation, prepare a source-qualified stock proposal with exact concentration/source context; otherwise document the precise remaining evidence. Keep raw labels and occurrence provenance without global stock-to-solute equivalence. Re-review the corrected exact payloads independently and regenerate the worker native report. Published prior evidence stays immutable.

Exact finding: `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/cross-shard-reconciliation-v1/finding-g12-mg-stock-scope-v1.json`, SHA256 `37771803c93ebe38644785034a54b9c50e8ddf5d610821053c75bfb4df0c612a`. Case `CM_NAME:9dd78dd62f6762ad602b4126b067042b0cc68ba65bd212f9a10b07ec20b33e8e`; proposal `B-PROPOSAL-Mgso4_X_7_H2o`, payload SHA256 `e898e16739bc1bb152cffc32fe6903ea3b64c668cdab626860009770acb97149`. The coordinator verified current head, proposal/ledger hashes and primary captures. Deduplication inspected662 current issues and found no exact existing stock-scope finding.

This is a source-case and alias-scope correction under MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md sections3 and6; it is not an authorization to merge owners, edit CultureMech, approve roles or transfer release support.
title: Separate MgSO4 heptahydrate stock occurrences from the resolving solute alias
